# Draft:ApPello Banking Software

ApPello
ApPello Ltd. is a Hungarian financial technology (fintech) company that develops digital lending and banking software for financial institutions. The company provides platforms supporting loan origination, loan servicing, decision automation, and related banking workflows. It was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Budapest, Hungary.
ApPello’s software products are primarily used by banks and financial institutions to digitize lending processes and automate credit decision workflows. The company operates mainly in the banking technology and enterprise software sectors and provides solutions to financial institutions in Europe and other international markets.
History
ApPello was founded in 1998 by Béla Vér and Krisztián Pálmai. The company was established to develop software solutions aimed at improving operational efficiency and digital capabilities in banking systems.
Since its founding, ApPello has focused on software platforms supporting the digital transformation of lending processes in banks and financial institutions. The company’s products have been implemented in several countries, including Austria, Croatia, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Romania, Slovakia, the United Kingdom, and the United Arab Emirates.
Products and services
ApPello develops enterprise software systems designed for financial institutions. Its platforms support various aspects of the lending lifecycle and banking operations, including credit decision automation and risk management.
Key product areas include:
Loan origination systems for retail, SME, and corporate lending
Loan servicing and management platforms
Credit decision engines used for automated underwriting and scoring
Trade finance solutions for guarantees and letters of credit
Debt collection and monitoring tools
Low-code platforms and AI-supported banking workflows
These systems are designed to automate lending workflows, support risk management processes, and integrate with banks’ core systems and IT infrastructure.
Technology
ApPello’s software products are built on a proprietary digital platform designed for configurable banking workflows and modular deployment. The platform supports cloud-ready infrastructure and configurable product development through low-code tools.
The company’s technology stack is designed to support automated credit decisioning, workflow orchestration, and integration with external data sources and banking systems.
Operations
ApPello is headquartered in Budapest, Hungary, and maintains offices in Vienna, Prague, and Bucharest.
Its digital lending software platforms are used by financial institutions across several European markets and other international jurisdictions.
Management
Béla Vér – Chief Executive Officer and co-founder.
Industry
ApPello operates in the financial technology sector, specifically in banking software and digital lending platforms designed to support the automation and digital transformation of lending processes in financial institutions.
